name: Duplicate Leads
query:
SELECT 
    l.company_name AS business_name,
    l.mobile_no,
    COUNT(l.mobile_no) AS mobile_count,
    l.custom_cnic,
    COUNT(l.custom_cnic) AS cnic_count,
    COUNT(l.name) AS total_leads,
    GROUP_CONCAT(l.name SEPARATOR ', ') AS duplicate_leads
FROM `tabLead` l
GROUP BY l.mobile_no, l.custom_cnic
HAVING COUNT(l.name) > 1
ORDER BY total_leads DESC
